sources.title: AI + Formal Methods
sources.snippet: AI can automate the most difficult and time-consuming parts of formal verification - including coordinating tools, generating specifications, proving theorems, and verifying AI-generated code. This makes formal methods dramatically faster, cheaper, easier for non-experts to use - practical and scalable across larger projects and more systems.

sources.title: Neural machine translation - Wikipedia
sources.snippet: Neural machine translation (NMT) is an approach to machine translation that uses an artificial neural network to predict the likelihood of a sequence of words, typically modeling entire sentences in a single integrated model.

sources.title: Neural Machine Translation (NMT) | Google Cloud Documentation
sources.snippet: Neural Machine Translation (NMT) model Google's standard Neural Machine Translation (NMT) has evolved from the neural network translation system that Google introduced in November 2016, with many improvements. It can translate to and from many languages in real time. Its model ID is general/nmt.
